author: Kevin B. Liu
description: The owner's picks from the close-up and elevated rounds that had not shipped (2026-11-22): each a scene staged in the Scene Studio and rendered at 4K by the game engine, at 1920 and its smaller rungs. The media library shows them (public/media/library-r3).
sources: the 4K stills of the Scene Studio renders under shots/media-r5/site50/stills-275 (each item's source names its file, its revision the commit it was rendered on)
